mapper.sql: c.id, c.provider_catalog_id, p.provider_code AS provider_type, c.name, c.base_url, c.endpoint_path, c.protocol, c.credential_ciphertext, c.credential_iv, c.credential_key_version, c.credential_masked, c.enabled, c.timeout_ms, c.input_price_per_million, c.output_price_per_million, c.last_test_status, c.last_tested_at, c.last_test_latency_ms, c.last_error_code, c.last_error_summary, c.configuration_version, c.deleted_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at, mp.id AS model_profile_id, mp.model_name, mp.display_name AS model_display_name, mp.supported_protocols, mp.capabilities_json AS model_capabilities_json, mp.default_parameters_json
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM provider_catalog WHERE provider_code = #{providerType} AND enabled = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_connection(provider_catalog_id, name, base_url, endpoint_path, protocol, credential_ciphertext, credential_iv, credential_key_version, credential_masked, enabled, timeout_ms, input_price_per_million, output_price_per_million, last_test_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{providerCatalogId}, #{name}, #{baseUrl}, #{endpointPath}, #{protocol}, #{credentialCiphertext}, #{credentialIv}, #{credentialKeyVersion}, #{credentialMasked}, #{enabled}, #{timeoutMs}, #{inputPricePerMillion}, #{outputPricePerMillion}, #{lastTestStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO model_profile(connection_id, model_name, display_name, supported_protocols, capabilities_json, default_parameters_json, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{modelName}, #{modelDisplayName}, #{supportedProtocols}, #{capabilitiesJson}, #{defaultParametersJson}, 1, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_connection c JOIN provider_catalog p ON p.id = c.provider_catalog_id JOIN model_profile mp ON mp.connection_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM ai_connection c JOIN provider_catalog p ON p.id = c.provider_catalog_id JOIN model_profile mp ON mp.connection_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM ai_connection c JOIN provider_catalog p ON p.id = c.provider_catalog_id JOIN model_profile mp ON mp.connection_id = c.id WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.enabled = #{enabled} ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE model_profile SET model_name = #{modelName}, display_name = #{modelDisplayName}, supported_protocols = #{supportedProtocols}, capabilities_json = #{capabilitiesJson}, default_parameters_json = #{defaultParametersJson}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{modelProfileId} AND connection_id = #{id}

UPDATE ai_connection SET enabled = #{enabled}, configuration_version = configuration_version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND configuration_version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE ai_connection SET enabled = 0, credential_ciphertext = NULL, credential_iv = NULL, credential_key_version = NULL, credential_masked = NULL, configuration_version = configuration_version + 1, deleted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND configuration_version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO connection_test_record(connection_id, protocol, model_name, streaming, status, http_status, latency_ms, event_count, done_marker_received, error_code, error_summary, capabilities_json, configuration_version, tested_at) VALUES(#{connectionId}, #{protocol}, #{modelName}, #{streaming}, #{status}, #{httpStatus}, #{latencyMs}, #{eventCount}, #{doneMarkerReceived}, #{errorCode}, #{errorSummary}, #{capabilitiesJson}, #{configurationVersion}, #{testedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_connection WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (input_price_per_million IS NOT NULL OR output_price_per_million IS NOT NULL)
